title: Remove the Outcast
prompt: guests = ["ana", "bo", "cy", "bo"] is given. Remove BOTH occurrences of "bo" and print the remaining list.

tests.name: both removed
tests.code:
assert printed and "bo" not in printed[0] and "ana" in printed[0] and "cy" in printed[0], f"got {printed}"
assert "remove(" in code or "bo" in code, "remove every occurrence of bo"
tests.hint: One remove() call only drops the first match — loop or count.
